verses.mystical_translation: Preserve me, O the Divine: for in thee do I put my trust.
O my whole being, thou hast said unto the Living Presence, Thou art my Holy Presence: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
the Living Presence is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
I will bless the Living Presence, who hath given me counsel: my innermost being also instruct me in the night seasons.
I have set the Living Presence always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
For you will not abandon my being to Sheol, nor let your faithful one see the Pit [or corruption].
Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

contemplative_note: The path of life is pictured as presence, counsel, belonging, and joy rather than fear.
safety_note: Afterlife language and “other gods” language should be translated historically and not used to persecute other religions or spiritual practices.
